findings.code_snippet: from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa, ec, padding, dsa
findings.rationale: Import of 'cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.rsa' indicates usage of RSA, which is quantum-vulnerable.
findings.quantum_threat_level: Shor's algorithm can factor RSA moduli in polynomial time on a cryptographically-relevant quantum computer (CRQC), completely breaking RSA key exchange and encryption.
